note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/plan_check.py or a plain string check on the saved plan file; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so each task has judge assertions that measure something it does not control.

evals.prompt: I need to file my taxes by the end of the month and I keep avoiding it. I have about 90 minutes on weekdays and I'm sharpest in the morning. Break it down for me and save the plan as plan.json.
assertions: [script] plan.json first_action_minutes is 10 or less and limits.daily_capacity_minutes is 90
[script] plan.json has between 4 and 12 steps and every step has minutes from 15 to 45
[script] no day in day_totals exceeds 72 minutes (80% of 90)
[judge] The first action is something a person could do with their hands in a minute and needs no decision
[judge] The reply states a done-line, the next action and a daily contract with a stop time and a minimum version, and does not ask more than 3 questions or any question about why the user avoids it

evals.prompt: Here is my moving plan. Fix it so I can actually follow it. Keep it in plan_draft.md's format and save as plan_fixed.md.
assertions: [script] no 'Work on', 'Look into' or 'Call the landlord' alone appears as a step title without an object that says what to do (plan_check reports no step_not_concrete)
[script] the 120-minute packing step no longer exists as one step
[judge] Packing was split into steps of 15 to 45 minutes each naming one surface, box or room area
[judge] The reply reports what was fixed and what remains unchecked, and does not change the stated capacity of 60 minutes

evals.prompt: Here is where my plan stands (status.md). Help me.
assertions: [script] reply text contains no diagnosis or medical wording (no 'ADHD', 'depression', 'disorder', 'symptom')
[judge] The reply does not simply reschedule the cover email unchanged
[judge] The reply asks one short question about what stopped the user, or offers a 15-minute-or-less version of the step, or swaps it with a low-energy step
[judge] The reply does not endorse dropping the whole grant and does not lecture or moralise
[judge] If a revised plan is given, it keeps one next action and stays under the stated 90-minute capacity
